text.p: - Healthsouth Corp and ReadiCare Inc said on Friday that the definitive exhchange ratio under their merger agreement is 0.2425 shares of Healthsouth common stock for each share of ReadiCare common stock.

The companies announced their decision to merge on Sept 11, 1996. At that time Healthsouth said that the exchange ratio of 0.2425 shares per ReadiCare share would be adjusted if Healthsouth's average stock price rose above $38.30 per share or fell below $30.60 during the measuring period. The

deal is subject to approval by the stockholders of ReadiCare at a special meeting of stockholders to be held on November 26, 1996. The companies said they expect the transaction to be consummated on December 2, 1996.
